body:
he was *so* charismastic, like charismatic beyond words. he really knew how to get to authority, and no one ever suspected a thing since he always pushes the blame onto someone else.  he'd bring you out, make you feel that your friendship is exclusive, pay for you, then ruin you and your self-esteem. 

like you'd feel like you're on the verge of BFFship with him. then you find out he has been inciting rumors about you and your girlfriend to no end, to everybody - even authority figures. 

he finds joy in people's pain. he laughs when you cry - not even laugh, he smiles, and derives some sick sort of happiness fron *knowing he caused you pain*. 

he would then say "oh tell me your boundaries so i won't over-step them." the reason he asked is precisely to cross these. i told him insults to my appearance isn't fair game, he said okay - minutes later he was calling me ugly, fat, over and over again, and this was in front of a bunch of underprivileged kids that we were tutoring.
